datasets.name: 367ba156
queryLines:
SELECT
  name,
  value.value
FROM
  sat.security_analysis.account_info ai,
  sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw
where
  category = 'Account Stats'
  and run_id = coalesce (
    (
      select
        max(run_id)
      from
        sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc,
        sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw
      where
        concat(aw.workspace_name, " (", aw.workspace_id, ")") = :workspaceid
        and completed = true
        and chk_date = :date_param
        and aw.analysis_enabled = true
        and aw.workspace_id = wrc.workspace_id
    ),
    (
      select
        max(run_id)
      from
        sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc,
        sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw
      where
        concat(aw.workspace_name, " (", aw.workspace_id, ")") = :workspaceid
        and completed = true
    )
  )
  and concat(aw.workspace_name, " (", aw.workspace_id, ")") = :workspaceid
  and aw.workspace_id = ai.workspaceid
ORDER BY
  name

datasets.name: 5e73087c
queryLines:
Select
  concat(
    results.category,
    ' (Out of ',
    category_count,
    ')'
  ) as category,
  severity,
  severity_count,
  ord
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      sbp.category,
      sbp.severity,
      count(sbp.severity) severity_count,
      CASE
        WHEN sbp.severity = 'High' THEN 3
        WHEN sbp.severity = 'Medium' THEN 2
        ELSE 1
      END as ord
    FROM
      sat.security_analysis.security_checks sc,
      sat.security_analysis.security_best_practices sbp,
      sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw
    where
      score = 1
      and sc.id = sbp.id
      and run_id = coalesce (
        (
          select
            max(run_id)
          from
            sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc,
            sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw
          where
            concat(aw.workspace_name, " (", aw.workspace_id, ")") = :workspaceid
            and aw.workspace_id = wrc.workspace_id
            and completed = true
            and chk_date = :date_param
            and aw.analysis_enabled = true
        ),
        (
          select
            max(run_id)
          from
            sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc,
            sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw
          where
            concat(aw.workspace_name, " (", aw.workspace_id, ")") = :workspaceid
            and aw.workspace_id = wrc.workspace_id
            and completed = true
        )
      )
      and category not IN ('Workspace Settings', 'Workspace Stats')
      and concat(aw.workspace_name, " (", aw.workspace_id, ")") = :workspaceid
      and sc.workspaceid = aw.workspace_id
    group by
      sbp.category,
      sbp.severity
  ) as results,
  (
    SELECT
      category,
      count(*) as category_count
    FROM
      sat.security_analysis.security_best_practices
    WHERE
      category not IN ('Workspace Settings', 'Workspace Stats')
    group by
      category
  ) as master
where
  results.category = master.category

datasets.name: f1a73f2e
queryLines:
WITH workspace_info AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id
  FROM
    sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces
  WHERE
    concat(workspace_name, " (", workspace_id, ")") = :workspaceid
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_run AS (
  SELECT
    run_id
  FROM
    sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc
  JOIN workspace_info wi
    ON wrc.workspace_id = wi.workspace_id
  WHERE
    wrc.completed = true
    AND wrc.chk_date <= :date_param
  ORDER BY
    wrc.chk_date DESC,
    wrc.run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  date_format(
    from_utc_timestamp(max(sc.check_time), 'America/New_York'),
    'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm a'
  ) AS date
FROM
  sat.security_analysis.security_checks sc
JOIN workspace_info wi
  ON sc.workspaceid = wi.workspace_id
JOIN latest_run lr
  ON sc.run_id = lr.run_id;

datasets.name: 9264c052
queryLines:
WITH chosen_date AS (
    -- Determine the relevant date to pull runs from
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT MAX(chk_date)
             FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete
             WHERE completed = true AND chk_date = :date_param),
            (SELECT MAX(chk_date)
             FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete
             WHERE completed = true AND chk_date < :date_param)
        ) AS chk_date
)
SELECT
    aw.workspace_id AS value,
    CONCAT(aw.workspace_name, ' (', aw.workspace_id, ')') AS name
FROM
    sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw,
    chosen_date cd
WHERE
    aw.analysis_enabled = true
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc
        WHERE wrc.workspace_id = aw.workspace_id
          AND wrc.completed = true
          AND wrc.chk_date = cd.chk_date
    )
ORDER BY
    aw.workspace_id ASC;

datasets.name: 5d41c7dd
queryLines:
WITH chosen_date AS (
    -- Determine the effective run date: today if scans exist, else the last available date
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (SELECT MAX(chk_date)
         FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete
         WHERE completed = true AND chk_date = :date_param),
        (SELECT MAX(chk_date)
         FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete
         WHERE completed = true AND chk_date < :date_param)
    ) AS chk_date
),
LatestRuns AS (
    -- Get the latest run per workspace but only on the chosen date
    SELECT 
        wrc.workspace_id,
        MAX(wrc.run_id) AS latest_run_id
    FROM 
        sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc,
        chosen_date cd
    WHERE 
        wrc.completed = TRUE
        AND wrc.chk_date = cd.chk_date
    GROUP BY 
        wrc.workspace_id
)
SELECT 
    CONCAT(aw.workspace_name, ' (', aw.workspace_id, ')') AS Workspace_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sbp.severity = 'High'   THEN 1 END) AS High,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sbp.severity = 'Medium' THEN 1 END) AS Medium,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sbp.severity = 'Low'    THEN 1 END) AS Low
FROM sat.security_analysis.security_checks sc
JOIN sat.security_analysis.security_best_practices sbp 
    ON sc.id = sbp.id
JOIN sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw 
    ON sc.workspaceid = aw.workspace_id
JOIN LatestRuns lr 
    ON sc.workspaceid = lr.workspace_id 
    AND sc.run_id = lr.latest_run_id
WHERE sc.score = 1
GROUP BY Workspace_name, aw.workspace_id
ORDER BY High DESC;

datasets.name: e6b69091
queryLines:
WITH severities AS (
  SELECT 'High' AS severity, 3 AS ord
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Low', 1
),
chosen_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(chk_date) AS chk_date
  FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete
  WHERE completed = true
    AND chk_date <= :date_param
),
latest_runs AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, run_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      wrc.workspace_id,
      wrc.run_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY wrc.workspace_id
        ORDER BY wrc.chk_date DESC, wrc.run_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc
    WHERE wrc.completed = true
      AND wrc.chk_date = (SELECT chk_date FROM chosen_date)
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
master AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS category_count
  FROM sat.security_analysis.security_best_practices
  WHERE category NOT IN ('Workspace Settings', 'Workspace Stats')
    AND enable = 1
    AND azure = 1
  GROUP BY category
),
workspace_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lr.workspace_id) AS ws_count
  FROM latest_runs lr
),
results AS (
  SELECT
    sbp.category,
    sbp.severity,
    COUNT(*) AS severity_count
  FROM sat.security_analysis.security_checks sc
  JOIN sat.security_analysis.security_best_practices sbp
    ON sc.id = sbp.id
  JOIN latest_runs lr
    ON sc.run_id = lr.run_id
   AND sc.workspaceid = lr.workspace_id
  WHERE sc.score = 1
    AND sbp.category NOT IN ('Workspace Settings', 'Workspace Stats')
    AND sbp.enable = 1
    AND sbp.azure = 1
  GROUP BY sbp.category, sbp.severity
),
category_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.category,
    SUM(r.severity_count) AS total_deviations
  FROM results r
  GROUP BY r.category
)
SELECT
  m.category AS category,
  m.category_count AS total_checks_per_workspace,
  s.severity,
  COALESCE(r.severity_count, 0) AS severity_count,
  s.ord,
  COALESCE(ct.total_deviations, 0) AS total_deviations,
  CONCAT(
    (m.category_count * wc.ws_count - COALESCE(ct.total_deviations, 0)),
    '/', 
    (m.category_count * wc.ws_count),
    ' passed'
  ) AS passed_checks,
  try_divide(
    (m.category_count * wc.ws_count - COALESCE(ct.total_deviations, 0))::decimal,
    NULLIF(m.category_count * wc.ws_count, 0)
  ) AS category_pct
FROM master m
CROSS JOIN severities s
CROSS JOIN workspace_count wc
LEFT JOIN results r
  ON m.category = r.category AND s.severity = r.severity
LEFT JOIN category_totals ct
  ON m.category = ct.category
ORDER BY m.category, s.ord DESC;

datasets.name: 966f5f55
queryLines:
WITH job_info AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    job_id,
    name AS job_name
  FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
 WHERE trim(regexp_replace(name, '\\s+', ' '))
       LIKE ANY ('%SAT Driver Notebook%', '%Secrets Scanner%')
       and lower(trim(regexp_replace(name, '\\s+', ' '))) like '%canary%'
),
job_runs AS (
  SELECT
    t.run_id,
    t.job_id,
    t.period_start_time,
    t.period_end_time,
    j.job_name
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t
  JOIN job_info j
    ON t.job_id = j.job_id
  WHERE t.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED'
),
latest_per_job AS (
  SELECT
    jr.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY jr.job_name
      ORDER BY jr.period_start_time DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM job_runs jr
  WHERE date(from_utc_timestamp(jr.period_start_time, 'America/New_York')) <= :date_param
)
SELECT
  lr.job_name,
  lr.job_id,
  date_format(from_utc_timestamp(lr.period_start_time, 'America/New_York'), 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm a') AS period_start_time_local,
  date_format(from_utc_timestamp(lr.period_end_time, 'America/New_York'), 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm a') AS period_end_time_local,
  ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, lr.period_start_time, lr.period_end_time) / 60, 2) AS duration_minutes
FROM latest_per_job lr
WHERE lr.rn = 1
ORDER BY lr.period_start_time DESC;  -- latest run first

datasets.name: 6ef3dafc
queryLines:
WITH chosen_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(chk_date) AS chk_date
    FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete
    WHERE completed = TRUE
      AND chk_date <= :date_param
),
latest_runs AS (
    SELECT workspace_id, run_id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            wrc.workspace_id,
            wrc.run_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY wrc.workspace_id
                ORDER BY wrc.chk_date DESC, wrc.run_id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc
        WHERE wrc.completed = TRUE
          AND wrc.chk_date = (SELECT chk_date FROM chosen_date)
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    concat(aw.workspace_name, ' (', aw.workspace_id, ')') AS workspace,
    COUNT(*) AS total_deviations
FROM sat.security_analysis.security_checks sc
JOIN sat.security_analysis.security_best_practices sbp
  ON sc.id = sbp.id
JOIN sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw
  ON sc.workspaceid = aw.workspace_id
JOIN latest_runs lr
  ON sc.run_id = lr.run_id
 AND sc.workspaceid = lr.workspace_id
WHERE sbp.category = :category
  AND sc.score = 1
GROUP BY aw.workspace_name, aw.workspace_id
ORDER BY total_deviations DESC;

datasets.name: 11d2fe5c
queryLines:
WITH param_ws AS (
  SELECT
    regexp_extract(:workspaceid, '\\((\\d+)\\)', 1) AS ws_id
),
latest_run AS (
  SELECT coalesce(
      (
        SELECT max(run_id)
        FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc
        JOIN sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw2
          ON aw2.workspace_id = wrc.workspace_id
        JOIN param_ws p
          ON aw2.workspace_id = p.ws_id
        WHERE completed = true
          AND chk_date = :date_param
          AND aw2.analysis_enabled = true
      ),
      (
        SELECT max(run_id)
        FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc
        JOIN param_ws p
          ON wrc.workspace_id = p.ws_id
        WHERE completed = true
      )
  ) AS run_id
)
SELECT
  aw.workspace_name,  -- ✅ real friendly name
  MAX(CASE WHEN ai.name = 'AS-5' THEN ai.value.value END) AS workspace_id,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ai.name = 'AS-2' THEN ai.value.value END) AS region,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ai.name = 'AS-4' THEN ai.value.value END) AS sku,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ai.name = 'AS-6' THEN ai.value.value END) AS status
FROM
  sat.security_analysis.account_info ai
JOIN sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces aw
  ON aw.workspace_id = ai.workspaceid
JOIN param_ws p
  ON aw.workspace_id = p.ws_id
JOIN latest_run lr
  ON ai.run_id = lr.run_id
WHERE
  ai.category = 'Account Stats'
GROUP BY
  aw.workspace_name;

WHERE sbp.category = :category
  AND sc.score = 1
GROUP BY aw.workspace_name, aw.workspace_id
ORDER BY total_deviations DESC;

datasets.name: b713809b
queryLines:
WITH param_ws AS (
  -- Normalize dropdown parameter: extracts numeric ID if format is "Name (12345)"
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_extract(:workspaceid, '\\((\\d+)\\)', 1), ''), :workspaceid) AS ws_id
),
severities AS (
  SELECT 'High' AS severity, 3 AS ord
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Low', 1
),
chosen_date AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
           (SELECT MAX(chk_date)
            FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete
            WHERE completed = true
              AND chk_date = :date_param),
           (SELECT MAX(chk_date)
            FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete
            WHERE completed = true
              AND chk_date < :date_param)
         ) AS chk_date
),
latest_run AS (
  SELECT t.workspace_id, t.run_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      wrc.workspace_id,
      wrc.run_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY wrc.workspace_id
        ORDER BY wrc.chk_date DESC, wrc.run_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete wrc
    JOIN param_ws p
      ON wrc.workspace_id = p.ws_id
    WHERE wrc.completed = true
      AND wrc.chk_date = (SELECT chk_date FROM chosen_date)
  ) t
  WHERE t.rn = 1
),
master AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS category_count
  FROM sat.security_analysis.security_best_practices
  WHERE category NOT IN ('Workspace Settings', 'Workspace Stats')
    AND enable = 1
    AND azure = 1
  GROUP BY category
),
results AS (
  SELECT
    sbp.category,
    sbp.severity,
    COUNT(*) AS severity_count
  FROM sat.security_analysis.security_checks sc
  JOIN sat.security_analysis.security_best_practices sbp
    ON sc.id = sbp.id
  JOIN latest_run lr
    ON sc.run_id = lr.run_id
   AND sc.workspaceid = lr.workspace_id
  WHERE sc.score = 1
    AND sbp.category NOT IN ('Workspace Settings', 'Workspace Stats')
    AND sbp.enable = 1
    AND sbp.azure = 1
  GROUP BY sbp.category, sbp.severity
),
category_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.category,
    SUM(r.severity_count) AS total_deviations
  FROM results r
  GROUP BY r.category
)
SELECT
  m.category AS category,
  m.category_count AS total_checks,
  s.severity,
  COALESCE(r.severity_count, 0) AS severity_count,
  s.ord,
  COALESCE(ct.total_deviations, 0) AS total_deviations,
  CONCAT(
    (m.category_count - COALESCE(ct.total_deviations, 0)),
    '/', 
    m.category_count,
    ' passed'
  ) AS passed_checks,
  try_divide(
    (m.category_count - COALESCE(ct.total_deviations, 0))::decimal,
    NULLIF(m.category_count, 0)
  ) AS category_pct
FROM master m
CROSS JOIN severities s
LEFT JOIN results r
  ON m.category = r.category AND s.severity = r.severity
LEFT JOIN category_totals ct
  ON m.category = ct.category
ORDER BY m.category, s.ord DESC;

datasets.name: 9f4edcfc
queryLines:
WITH job_info AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    job_id,
    name AS job_name
  FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
--  WHERE trim(regexp_replace(name, '\s+', ' ')) = 'SAT Driver Notebook'
  WHERE trim(regexp_replace(name, '\s+', ' ')) = '[canary] SAT Driver Notebook'
),
job_runs AS (
  SELECT
    t.run_id,
    t.job_id,
    t.period_start_time,
    t.period_end_time,
    j.job_name
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t
  JOIN job_info j
    ON t.job_id = j.job_id
  WHERE t.result_state = 'SUCCEEDED'
    -- keep only the final timeline row for each run
    AND t.period_end_time = (
      SELECT MAX(t2.period_end_time)
      FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline t2
      WHERE t2.run_id = t.run_id
    )
),
latest_run AS (
  SELECT run_id
  FROM job_runs
  WHERE date(period_start_time) <= :date_param
  ORDER BY period_start_time DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  j.job_name,
  j.job_id,
  date_format(from_utc_timestamp(j.period_start_time, 'America/New_York'), 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm a') AS period_start_time_local,
  date_format(from_utc_timestamp(j.period_end_time, 'America/New_York'), 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm a') AS period_end_time_local,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, j.period_start_time, j.period_end_time) / 60 AS duration_minutes
FROM job_runs j
JOIN latest_run lr
  ON j.run_id = lr.run_id;

datasets.name: 00e28eff
queryLines:
WITH latest_runs AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, MAX(run_id) AS latest_run_id
  FROM (
    SELECT workspace_id, run_id FROM sat.security_analysis.notebooks_secret_scan_results
    UNION ALL
    SELECT workspace_id, run_id FROM sat.security_analysis.clusters_secret_scan_results
  )
  GROUP BY workspace_id
),
combined_results AS (
  SELECT
    'notebook' AS source_type,
    s.notebook_id AS object_id,
    s.workspace_id,
    s.detector_name,
    s.secret_sha256,
    s.verified,
    s.secrets_found,
    s.run_id,
    s.scan_time
  FROM sat.security_analysis.notebooks_secret_scan_results s
  JOIN latest_runs l ON s.workspace_id = l.workspace_id AND s.run_id = l.latest_run_id
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'cluster' AS source_type,
    s.cluster_id AS object_id,
    s.workspace_id,
    s.detector_name,
    s.secret_sha256,
    s.verified,
    s.secrets_found,
    s.run_id,
    s.scan_time
  FROM sat.security_analysis.clusters_secret_scan_results s
  JOIN latest_runs l ON s.workspace_id = l.workspace_id AND s.run_id = l.latest_run_id
),
notebooks_with_secrets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id, object_id
  FROM combined_results
  WHERE source_type = 'notebook' AND secrets_found > 0
),
clusters_with_secrets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id, object_id
  FROM combined_results
  WHERE source_type = 'cluster' AND secrets_found > 0
),
unique_secrets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT secret_sha256
  FROM combined_results
  WHERE secret_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND secrets_found > 0
),
total_findings AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(secret_sha256, '|', detector_name, '|', object_id)) AS total_count
  FROM combined_results
  WHERE secrets_found > 0
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN nws.object_id IS NOT NULL OR cws.object_id IS NOT NULL THEN cr.workspace_id END) AS workspaces_with_secrets,
  COUNT(DISTINCT nws.object_id) AS notebooks_with_secrets,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cws.object_id) AS clusters_with_secrets,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unique_secrets) AS unique_secrets_detected,
  (SELECT total_count FROM total_findings) AS total_secret_findings,
  date_format(
    from_utc_timestamp(MAX(cr.scan_time), 'America/New_York'),
    'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm a'
  ) AS latest_scan_time_est
FROM combined_results cr
LEFT JOIN notebooks_with_secrets nws ON cr.workspace_id = nws.workspace_id AND cr.source_type = 'notebook' AND cr.object_id = nws.object_id
LEFT JOIN clusters_with_secrets cws ON cr.workspace_id = cws.workspace_id AND cr.source_type = 'cluster' AND cr.object_id = cws.object_id
GROUP BY 1=1;

datasets.name: 6dbb433f
queryLines:
WITH latest_run AS (
  -- Get latest run_id for specific workspace from both notebooks and clusters
  SELECT workspace_id, MAX(run_id) AS latest_run_id
  FROM (
    SELECT workspace_id, run_id FROM sat.security_analysis.notebooks_secret_scan_results WHERE workspace_id = :workspace_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT workspace_id, run_id FROM sat.security_analysis.clusters_secret_scan_results WHERE workspace_id = :workspace_id
  )
  GROUP BY workspace_id
),
combined_results AS (
  -- Notebooks
  SELECT
    'notebook' AS source_type,
    url_decode(s.notebook_path) AS object_path,
    s.notebook_name AS object_name,
    NULL AS config_field,
    NULL AS config_key,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.detector_name = 'CustomRegex' THEN 'Custom Secrets'
      ELSE s.detector_name 
    END AS detection_type,
    s.secret_sha256 AS secret_hash,
    s.verified,
    s.scan_time
  FROM sat.security_analysis.notebooks_secret_scan_results s
  JOIN latest_run l ON s.workspace_id = l.workspace_id AND s.run_id = l.latest_run_id
  WHERE s.secrets_found > 0
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Clusters
  SELECT
    'cluster' AS source_type,
    NULL AS object_path,
    s.cluster_name AS object_name,
    s.config_field,
    s.config_key,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.detector_name = 'CustomRegex' THEN 'Custom Secrets'
      ELSE s.detector_name 
    END AS detection_type,
    s.secret_sha256 AS secret_hash,
    s.verified,
    s.scan_time
  FROM sat.security_analysis.clusters_secret_scan_results s
  JOIN latest_run l ON s.workspace_id = l.workspace_id AND s.run_id = l.latest_run_id
  WHERE s.secrets_found > 0
),
deduped AS (
  SELECT
    source_type,
    object_path,
    object_name,
    config_field,
    config_key,
    detection_type,
    secret_hash,
    -- Prefer verified = true when duplicates exist
    MAX(CASE WHEN verified THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verified_flag,
    MAX(scan_time) AS scan_time
  FROM combined_results
  GROUP BY source_type, object_path, object_name, config_field, config_key, detection_type, secret_hash
)
SELECT
  source_type,
  object_path,
  object_name,
  config_field,
  config_key,
  detection_type,
  secret_hash,
  verified_flag = 1 AS verified,
  date_format(
    from_utc_timestamp(scan_time, 'America/New_York'),
    'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm a'
  ) AS scan_time_est
FROM deduped
ORDER BY source_type, object_name, detection_type;

datasets.name: 94728c57
queryLines:
WITH completed_runs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    wrc.workspace_id,
    wrc.run_id,
    wrc.chk_date,
    date(wrc.chk_date) AS chk_day,
    wrc.completed
  FROM sat.security_analysis.workspace_run_complete AS wrc
  INNER JOIN sat.security_analysis.account_workspaces AS aw
    ON wrc.workspace_id = aw.workspace_id
  WHERE concat(aw.workspace_name, " (", aw.workspace_id, ")") = :workspaceid
    AND wrc.completed = true
),

latest_run_per_day AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    chk_day,
    MAX(run_id) AS latest_run_id
  FROM completed_runs
  GROUP BY workspace_id, chk_day
),

check_scores AS (
  SELECT
    sc.workspaceid,
    cr.chk_day,
    bp.severity,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_checks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_checks,
    COUNT(*) AS total_checks
  FROM sat.security_analysis.security_checks AS sc
  INNER JOIN completed_runs AS cr
    ON sc.run_id = cr.run_id
   AND sc.workspaceid = cr.workspace_id
  INNER JOIN latest_run_per_day AS lr
    ON cr.workspace_id = lr.workspace_id
   AND cr.run_id = lr.latest_run_id
  INNER JOIN sat.security_analysis.security_best_practices AS bp
    ON sc.id = bp.id
  GROUP BY sc.workspaceid, cr.chk_day, bp.severity
)

SELECT
  chk_day AS scan_date,
  severity,
  SUM(passed_checks) AS passed,
  SUM(failed_checks) AS failed,
  SUM(total_checks) AS total
FROM check_scores
GROUP BY chk_day, severity
ORDER BY chk_day, severity;

WITH chosen_date AS (

),
ultima AS (

    u.findings_attempted,

    u.excecoes_com_tratativa,

FROM ultima u

frame.title: Workspace Deviations
frame.description:

### Network Security
---
Ensures secure, controlled connectivity for all Databricks resources through network isolation and access restrictions. Checks may include secure cluster connectivity, customer-managed VPCs or VNet injection, VPC peering, and IP access lists, with additional controls as needed.

### Identity & Access
---
Ensures that only authorized users and services can access Databricks resources. Checks may include single sign-on, SCIM-based user provisioning, role-based access control, and token management, with additional identity and access safeguards as needed.

### Data Protection
---
Ensures sensitive information is protected from unauthorized access, disclosure, or loss. Checks may include secrets management, encryption, and data exfiltration protections, along with other data security measures as needed.

### Governance
---
Ensures compliance, accountability, and standardized configurations across the Databricks environment. Checks may include cluster policies, audit logs (diagnostic logs on Azure), init scripts, and DBFS mounts, along with other governance controls as needed.

### Informational
---
Ensures visibility into workspace configuration and usage to support monitoring and decision-making. Checks may include admin counts, ACLs, user privileges, and library or repo usage, along with other informational insights as needed.

lines: ## Workflow Completeness
Effective coverage of the latest secret scan run in each workspace, on the selected date.

**Coverage** is the ratio of objects read to eligible objects. **Not read** are eligible objects that never reached the scanner due to permissions, throttling or a read failure. **Lost evidence** is a finding that failed to persist even after retries: any value above zero means the run saw a secret and could not record it.
If the selected date has no run, the page falls back to the most recent earlier run.

### Seguranca de Rede
---
Garante conectividade segura e controlada para todos os recursos do Databricks por meio de isolamento de rede e restricoes de acesso. As verificacoes podem incluir conectividade segura de cluster, VPCs gerenciadas pelo cliente ou injecao de VNet, VPC peering e listas de acesso por IP, alem de outros controles conforme necessario.

### Identidade e Acesso
---
Garante que apenas usuarios e servicos autorizados possam acessar os recursos do Databricks. As verificacoes podem incluir single sign-on, provisionamento de usuarios via SCIM, controle de acesso baseado em papeis (RBAC) e gestao de tokens, alem de outras salvaguardas de identidade e acesso conforme necessario.

### Protecao de Dados
---
Garante que informacoes sensiveis estejam protegidas contra acesso nao autorizado, divulgacao ou perda. As verificacoes podem incluir gestao de segredos, criptografia e protecoes contra exfiltracao de dados, alem de outras medidas de seguranca de dados conforme necessario.

### Governanca
---
Garante conformidade, responsabilizacao e configuracoes padronizadas em todo o ambiente Databricks. As verificacoes podem incluir politicas de cluster, logs de auditoria (diagnostic logs no Azure), init scripts e montagens DBFS, alem de outros controles de governanca conforme necessario.

### Informativo
---
Garante visibilidade sobre a configuracao e o uso do workspace para apoiar monitoramento e tomada de decisao. As verificacoes podem incluir contagem de administradores, ACLs, privilegios de usuario e uso de bibliotecas ou repositorios, alem de outras informacoes conforme necessario.

lines: ## Completude do Workflow
Cobertura efetiva da ultima execucao do scan de segredos em cada workspace, na data selecionada.

**Cobertura** e a razao entre objetos lidos e objetos elegiveis. **Nao lidos** sao elegiveis que nao chegaram ao scanner por permissao, throttling ou falha de leitura. **Evidencia perdida** e achado que falhou ao gravar mesmo apos os retries: qualquer valor acima de zero significa que a execucao viu um segredo e nao conseguiu registra-lo.
Se a data escolhida nao tem execucao, a pagina cai automaticamente na execucao anterior mais recente.
